title: Creeper-oid
description: a hostile robot-creeper hybrid that attacks players
body:
A mod that adds "creeper-oid" a hostile creeper/robot hybrid to minecraft

shoots fireballs, estimated to be as fast as a baby zombie
_______________________________________________________________________________________________

(currently only available for 1.20.1 forge)

(does not spawn naturally, only spawns via spawn eggs/commands)

loot:redstone comparator and 5 XP points

immune to:fall damage, anvils, fire, drowning

Health:100 hearts

specialized to combat against robbers and bad people uses a turret-like shooter to disarm bad people

attacks every player it sees, and players only

adds a new experience of creepers to the game

does not explode... yet
